summary: Creates the CRT private heap with HeapCreate, stores the selected heap type code in a global, then initializes the matching sub-allocator (msvcrt heap for type 3, slab/buddy allocator for type 2). Returns 1 on success, 0 if the heap or the sub-allocator initialization fails.

local_names.a1: HeapCreate flag word; when 0 the flag argument is zero
local_names.v1: heap type code returned by sub_593115 and stored in the global
local_names.v2: success flag returned by the chosen sub-allocator initializer
local_names.hHeap: global handle created by HeapCreate and stored at 0x008D4904

operations.description: Call HeapCreate with flag a1 == 0, initial size 0x1000, and 0 for the maximum size, storing the returned handle in the hHeap global.
If hHeap is null, the heap could not be created; return 0 immediately.
Call sub_593115 to determine the heap type code and store its return value in v1.
Write the heap type code v1 into the dword_8D4908 global for downstream use.
Branch on the heap type code: v1 == 3 selects the msvcrt heap initializer, v1 == 2 selects the slab/buddy allocator initializer, and any other value returns 1 without further initialization.
On the type 3 path, call sub_593DD3 with the size parameter 1016 to initialize the msvcrt heap; capture the success result in v2.
On the type 2 path, call SlabBuddyAllocatorInitialization to set up the slab/buddy allocator; capture the success result in v2.
If the chosen sub-allocator initializer returned 0 (failure), destroy the private heap with HeapDestroy and return 0.
Return 1 to report successful heap and sub-allocator initialization.
